name: date_trunc
spark_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST('2026-02-03 04:05:06' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS v
duckdb_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST('2026-02-03 04:05:06' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AS v

name: collect_list
spark_sql: SELECT COLLECT_LIST(v) AS v FROM VALUES (1), (2), (NULL) AS t(v)
duckdb_sql: SELECT ARRAY_AGG(v) FILTER(WHERE v IS NOT NULL) AS v FROM (VALUES (1), (2), (NULL)) AS t(v)

name: try_divide
spark_sql: SELECT TRY_DIVIDE(4, 0) AS v, TRY_DIVIDE(5, 2) AS w
duckdb_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN 0 <> 0 THEN 4 / 0 ELSE NULL END AS v, CASE WHEN 2 <> 0 THEN 5 / 2 ELSE NULL END AS w

name: qualify
spark_sql: SELECT v, rn FROM (SELECT v, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY v DESC) AS rn FROM VALUES (1), (2), (3) AS t(v)) AS _t WHERE rn = 1
duckdb_sql: SELECT v, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY v DESC) AS rn FROM (VALUES (1), (2), (3)) AS t(v) QUALIFY rn = 1
